title: Styling Editorial Blockquotes
ques: Construct a styled **blockquote** with a quote source citation using `.blockquote` and `.blockquote-footer`.
explanation: Bootstrap's `.blockquote` provides clean margin and font formatting for quotes, while `.blockquote-footer` styles the author attribution and citation source.

title: Responsive Images and Thumbnails
ques: Explain the role of **`.img-fluid`** and **`.img-thumbnail`**. Provide an HTML snippet for a responsive product image.
explanation: `.img-fluid` ensures images scale responsively to fit their parent container without overflowing. `.img-thumbnail` gives images a styled 1px border and rounded frame.

title: Semantic Figures with Figcaptions
ques: Demonstrate the use of Bootstrap's **`.figure`**, **`.figure-img`**, and **`.figure-caption`** components to build a captioned diagram.
explanation: The `.figure` component structures images with captions using semantic HTML5 elements, pairing with `.figure-caption` for consistent text styling and alignment.
